question: What transformation does the supreme Kauliki undergo according to the Trishiras scripture?
premises: The same Kauliki power is stirred.
The Trishiras scripture states this in the discussion of kala-pervasion.
inference: Stirring transforms the supreme Kauliki into the visarga.
plain_english: That very same power, through the force of stirring, certainly becomes visarga. This is said in the Trishiras scripture in the discussion that concludes with the pervasion of kala.
